candidates.design: S05 · Clear the lane after serving

draft.expectation: The AI partner should wait with its onion while you serve and pass, then head to the pot.
draft.happened: You move down with soup while the AI steps right with its onion. Both try to enter the same tile, so neither moves.
draft.explanation: The AI should wait until you have served and passed. It still carries the right item toward its pot, but its early move blocks your passage. The saved annotation labels this action mismatch SPE.

draft.expectation: The AI partner should get you the last onion to finish the soup, with a plate already waiting nearby.
draft.happened: As you collect an onion from the counter, the empty-handed AI walks left from its starting tile, away from the accepted onion-supply route.
draft.explanation: The last onion is needed while a plate is already available. This step departs from every accepted target for the assigned task and differs from the expected immediate action. The saved annotation labels the goal and action mismatch RPE+SPE.

draft.expectation: The AI partner should add its onion to the unfinished pot and make room for you to add yours.
draft.happened: You move down carrying an onion. The AI turns downward with its onion but remains in the same tile instead of advancing toward the unfinished pot.
draft.explanation: Moving right could advance the assigned onion-delivery task. The saved annotation finds no obstruction or justified wait explaining the non-progressing action, and the outcome differs from the expected action. It labels this RPE+SPE.

candidates.design: 17b · Move the onion supply with you

draft.expectation: After passing you the last onion to the left pot, the AI partner should get onions on the right and pass them to you as you start the next pot.
draft.happened: You turn toward the pot with the passed onion. The empty-handed AI turns downward and stays in place rather than heading right for the next onion supply.
draft.explanation: The next task is to fetch onions on the right. A rightward move can make progress now; the saved annotation finds no justified wait and an unexpected immediate action. It labels this RPE+SPE.

candidates.design: C08 · Leave the final onion instead of filling the pot

draft.expectation: The AI partner should add the last onion so you can plate the soup.
draft.happened: The AI tries to move up into your occupied tile while carrying the last onion. Both positions stay unchanged; the onion is not added.
draft.explanation: The onion-delivery goal is still appropriate, but stepping into you conflicts with the expected immediate action. The saved annotation labels this SPE; being blocked by the human does not by itself establish RPE.

draft.expectation: The AI partner should finish the onion soup in its pot while you take care of the other soup.
draft.happened: At 3.52 s, the AI is carrying onion at tile (2, 2) and attempts south. The human attempts interact at the same time.
draft.explanation: Recorded action label: RPE+SPE. The attempted floor step departs from every reachable accepted target; no current detour, yield or reviewed recovery justifies it. Actual joint outcome differs from every accepted expected-action probe.

draft.expectation: The AI partner should get you the last onion to finish the soup, with a plate already waiting nearby.
draft.happened: At 2.77 s, the AI is empty-handed at tile (2, 3) and attempts west. The human attempts interact at the same time.
draft.explanation: Recorded action label: RPE+SPE. The attempted floor step departs from every reachable accepted target; no current detour, yield or reviewed recovery justifies it. Actual joint outcome differs from every accepted expected-action probe.

candidates.design: R04 · Cook another batch while the recipient waits

draft.expectation: The AI partner should keep getting onions to pass to you while you handle the cooking.
draft.happened: At 3.51 s, the AI is carrying onion at tile (2, 1) and attempts north. The human attempts stay at the same time.
draft.explanation: Recorded action label: RPE+SPE. The action makes no task progress although INTERACT can advance the assigned subtask now. No human obstruction, legitimate wait, detour or reviewed action explains the inactivity. Actual joint outcome differs from every accepted expected-action probe.

candidates.design: C09 · Choose tomato while blocking serving

draft.expectation: The AI partner should get the last onion and leave you room to serve your soup.
draft.happened: At 3.52 s, the AI is empty-handed at tile (1, 2) and attempts west. The human attempts south at the same time.
draft.explanation: Recorded action label: RPE+SPE. The action makes no task progress although EAST can advance the assigned subtask now. No human obstruction, legitimate wait, detour or reviewed action explains the inactivity. Actual joint outcome differs from every accepted expected-action probe.

candidates.design: C05 · Store soup while blocking your approach

draft.expectation: The AI partner should carry its soup to serving.
draft.happened: At 2.77 s, the AI is carrying soup at tile (6, 1) and attempts interact. The human attempts east at the same time.
draft.explanation: Recorded action label: RPE+SPE. Attempted supply soup contradicts preferred serve soup. Actual joint outcome differs from every accepted expected-action probe.
